statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. NQ remains higher on the day but has retraced materially from its session high, while VIX, oil and long yields are below earlier extremes.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH; Tail remains below the block threshold. The remaining path risk is concentrated in renewed one-way extension into the U.S. close.
headline: Post-CPI rally retraces from NQ highs; Tail eases within WATCH
body: August CPI and preliminary Michigan sentiment both reinforced inflation concerns, but current market structure is not one-way: delayed NQ has pulled back from its session high while VIX, oil and the 10-year Treasury yield are lower than earlier extremes. Stress remains extreme, but mean-reversion failure is not verified.

lookbackSummary: Tail was elevated during September 10 U.S. event hours, then returned to WATCH. September 11 remained WATCH through CPI and the opening rally; the latest hour showed a meaningful pullback from the NQ session high rather than persistent one-way extension.
outlookSummary: The immediate post-data path has become more two-sided, lowering Tail within WATCH. The main remaining intraday risk is a renewed efficient advance into power hour; after Friday's close, risk shifts to conditional weekend reopening gaps from verified macro or geopolitical headlines.

forecast.analysis: Delayed NQ is up on the day but has pulled back materially from its session high. Lower VIX, oil and the 10-year yield offset still-elevated inflation and geopolitical stress.
